newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades YPF debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades YPF debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps said Thursday it upgraded the debt ratings of YPF SA to triple-B-minus from double-B on a foreign currency basis and to triple-B-plus from triple-B on a local currency basis.
The ratings apply to the senior unsecured obligations of the Argentine oil company.
Duff said it upgraded the rating on YPF's structured export notes to triple-B-plus from triple-B.

It noted that this rating is different from Duff's double-B rating on the Republic of Argentina, reflecting the growing significance of YPF's non-Argentine operations and the fundamental improvements in the company's credit profile.
